versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED (extraction/verify_all.py version_parity fails if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json). counts are MACHINE-CHECKED (manifest_counts recomputes every number from disk). repositoryVersion (= newest CHANGELOG heading) and pageSpecVersion (= the schema const, which PageSpecs must declare) are cross-checked by version_parity; bumping them stays a hand edit.

source.clone: React 18.3 + Vite 5 clone (sibling project, read-only); styling is the original compiled Tailwind v4 CSS
source.distribution: Private. Contains real company copy, real third-party reviews and references to proprietary media and a commercial font - do not publish this repository.

structure.routes: single real route '/' rendered as a 13-stop scroll-snapped story inside main[data-scroll-root]
outOfScope: /privacy-policy (linked, never captured; template.legal is generationEligible=false with zero nodes)

modes.reference: reproduces the Avec source; source roles allowed
modes.generated: a new page for another brand; only generation-safe roles, placeholder URLs, fictional reviews/people, placeholder rating, original copy
